groups.title: Domain-Driven Design Core
groups.question: Explain how domain-driven design helps you keep each service's model clean and consistent.

followUps.Bounded Contexts: Why does forcing one shared Order model across Sales and Fulfillment cause problems?
followUps.Aggregates and Consistency Boundaries: Why should a single transaction not span more than one aggregate?

groups.title: Service Contracts
groups.question: Explain how services can change their APIs and data independently without breaking each other.

followUps.API Versioning and Backward Compatibilit: Why does a breaking API change turn a release into a system-wide event without a versioning strategy?
followUps.Database-Per-Service Pattern: How do you answer a query that needs data from two services when each owns its own database?

groups.title: Context Mapping
groups.question: Explain how teams describe and protect the relationships between different parts of a domain.

followUps.Context Map and Integration Patterns: When would you put an anti-corruption layer in front of an upstream system, and what does it protect you from?
followUps.Ubiquitous Language: What kind of bugs appear when the names in the code drift away from the words the business uses?

groups.title: Design Validation
groups.question: Walk through how you would check that your service boundaries match the real business.

followUps.Event Storming for Service Boundaries: How does an event storming session help you find service boundaries?
followUps.Decomposition by Subdomain: How does the difference between core and generic subdomains change where you spend engineering effort?
